gen-gf-encode-sans-semi-condensed-fs-lit: Literata is a classic serif, sturdy and bookish. Encode Sans Semi Condensed keeps its pen-drawn strokes nearly uniform and open at the ends, while Literata lets its thick and thin lines show a gentle, visible swing.
gen-gf-encode-sans-semi-expanded-fs-lite: Encode Sans Semi Expanded has friendly terminals that never close in, and its low contrast keeps every letter straightforward. Literata's body can sit slightly smaller.
gen-gf-englebert-fs-literata: Crisp, tight-knit lettering up top, with an e that stays open and strokes of almost no variation, meets Literata's rounded, slightly thickening sides. Englebert and Literata make the difference itself the draw.
gen-gf-exo-fs-literata: Literata reads like a text serif with real backbone, its thin lines sturdy and its thick ones only a little heavier. Exo handles the headline with smooth, broad-nibbed curves left open, and Literata does the steadier work of carrying sentences.
gen-gf-exo-2-fs-literata: Clean and contemporary, Exo 2 ends its curves in clear daylight above a serif whose thin parts are plainly thinner yet never fragile. And Literata's sturdy thins are what make the two feel related despite the split.
gen-gf-fahkwang-fs-literata: Literata brings a sophisticated, bookish serif voice, with sturdy thin lines and curves that leave their mouths wide open. And Fahkwang's lettering-pen stroke, held steady with generous curls on g and s, gives the pairing its modern edge.
gen-gf-finger-paint-bitter: Commanding in presence, Finger Paint stacks tall bodies with capitals barely taller and crossbars as thick as its stems. Bitter, grounded and dependable, does the quieter work.
gen-gf-finger-paint-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans keeps its stroke weight constant, with c ends pointing apart like open pincers and almost no cap-to-lowercase step. Finger Paint's chunky, chalk-wide forms take the loud role above it.
gen-gf-finger-paint-poppins: Tall bodies that leave capitals barely taller give Finger Paint its blunt, chalky punch, with crossbars as thick as stems. It makes the statements; Poppins, loose-curved and sturdy, carries the rest.
gen-gf-finger-paint-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab reads precise and structured, its middle zone dominating each line and its open throats on a, c, e and s staying legible. And Finger Paint's pen-like constant weight above it makes a longer passage feel firm and steady.
